node.title: The H3 non-swap moment controls weighted Mobius excess
node.statement: PROVED REDUCTION. Put D(t)=#{a in A:a^2=t} and S_ns=sum_{t!=1}[P(t)(P(t)-2)+D(t)]R(t). Then 136X_35<=S_ns, so the estimate S_ns<=68n^2 would close f3_h3_mobius_excess_half. Here S_ns counts exactly the product-product-quotient incidences whose product representations are neither equal nor swaps. It is also exactly the number of quadruples (lambda,a,b,c) with a,lambda*a,b,b/lambda,c,abc in A, lambda!=1, lambda!=b/a, and ab!=1. The compiler constant is sharp at product multiplicities 68,69,70. This node proves the reduction only; the uniform 68n^2 estimate remains open work on the critical leaf.
